name: claude-code

detect.version_re_notes: `claude --version` prints e.g. "2.1.260 (Claude Code)" (live 2026-09-10). The npm global install puts only script shims on PATH; claude.cmd execs %dp0%\node_modules\@anthropic-ai\claude-code\bin\claude.exe directly (read 2026-09-10), so npm_exe resolves the REAL native binary under the shim's node_modules without a shell. (There is no package-level cli.js; the shim does not route through one.)

command.mode_args_notes: Evidence: code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference + 2026-09-09 native probe (tmp/agent-probe-20260909/claude*/). `-p` always starts at the default (Manual) tier; --permission-mode re-tiers per run. read-only = default tier + `--permission-prompts none` (2.1.259+): with no answer channel headless, every permission prompt is denied, so Write/Bash are refused while built-in read-only tools stay auto-allowed (P2 live: Write denied, permission_denials populated). workspace-write = acceptEdits (Edit/Write auto-accepted; Bash still prompts and is denied headless). unattended = bypassPermissions (everything auto-accepted; shell.exec verified live 2026-09-10, v2.1.260). There is NO env var for permission mode, and project-level settings defaultMode=auto/bypass do not apply to -p.
command.argv_notes: stream-json REQUIRES --verbose in print mode (cli-reference). Live stream shape sampled 2026-09-10 on v2.1.260: NDJSON on stdout = system/init event -> assistant events -> one terminal result event.

env._env_notes: native_default = paidan does not set the variable at all (claude runs against the user's real ~/.claude, incl. the ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN/ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateway entry in native settings.json env). Paidan never stages or copies claude config.

fs.read.via: built-in read-only tools (Read/Glob/Grep) are auto-allowed in every permission mode; static deny rules still apply on top

fs.write.via: acceptEdits auto-accepts Edit/Write (workspace-write); bypassPermissions for unattended; default+--permission-prompts none denies (P2 live 2026-09-09: permission_denials[Write], file not created)

shell.exec.via: Bash tool; auto-accepted only under bypassPermissions (verified live 2026-09-10: echo via shell ran, permission_denials empty); under acceptEdits/default a shell prompt has no headless answer channel and the call is denied

net.fetch.via: WebFetch/WebSearch appear in the init event tool list (live sample 2026-09-10); per-mode auto-allow behavior in print mode not probed

interact.ask.via: print mode has no user-answer channel; --permission-prompts none turns every prompt into a denial (P2 2026-09-09). --permission-prompt-tool exists but needs an MCP prompt tool paidan does not provide

permission.presets_notes: Six native tiers exist (default/acceptEdits/plan/auto/dontAsk/bypassPermissions); the three presets map to the tiers above. plan tier is interactive-shaped (plan approval prompt) so it is not used as the read-only mapping; default+--permission-prompts none gives a true enforced read-only headless tier (P2 live-verified 2026-09-09).

denial_evidence.via: stream-json terminal result event carries permission_denials[] ({tool_name, tool_use_id, tool_input}); the claude-stream-json parser surfaces them into result.json evidence notes (P2 live 2026-09-09: Write denial visible, exit 0, subtype success)

resume.notes: Session handle = session_id of the stream-json system/init event (a UUID; stable across resume — P3 2026-09-09 recalled P1 content with the same id). Official constraints (code.claude.com/docs/en, 2026-09-09): (1) `-p --resume` tiers by the NEW -p invocation (back to default/Manual) — nothing is inherited from the original run, so startup flags (--permission-mode/--model/--add-dir/--settings/--mcp-config) MUST be re-passed; paidan always re-splices mode_args/model_arg on resume, which satisfies this. (2) Two processes must NOT resume the same session concurrently — both would interleave writes into one transcript (officially warned; treated as forbidden). (3) --resume searches projects machine-wide (2.1.223+), so a same-cwd resume run resolves the session. Model on resume: inherited from transcript unless --model overrides.

models.notes: UNVERIFIED discovery: claude has no model-enumeration command. Known aliases (docs, 2026-09-09): sonnet/opus/haiku/fable/best via --model. Selection = config.json defaults.model; no cross-connection fallback. Current connection on this machine: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN + ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL self-hosted gateway via native settings.json env (no OAuth login; under -p an API key always beats a subscription login).

parser_notes: stdout NDJSON (stream-json): system/init carries session_id; assistant events carry message.content[] text parts; the single terminal result event carries result text, session_id (cross-checked against init), usage (input/output/cache tokens), total_cost_usd and permission_denials. Non-JSON lines / mid-line EOF / conflicting session ids degrade the parser (terminal judgment then cannot be exit-code-based).

capabilities._capabilities_notes: --bg exists but is mutually exclusive with -p, so no native background for print-mode runs.

effort.notes: `claude --help` 2.1.260: `--effort <level>  Effort level for the current session (low, medium, high, xhigh, max)`. Absent = claude's native session default applies; no cross-connection fallback.
